steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour a 9x13-inch pan. Stir sugar and apples together; set aside. Sift flour, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt together in a medium bowl.
Mix oil, eggs and vanilla together in a large bowl; add sugared apples. Stir in flour mixture and nuts. Pour cake batter into the prepared pan and spread evenly.
Bake in the preheated oven until cake springs back to the touch, about 45 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Autumn Apple Cake
raw_recipe.description: This recipe for fresh apple cake uses the best of fall apples and walnuts to make moist and nutty cake that keeps and freezes well.
raw_recipe.name: Autumn Apple Cake

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour a 9x13-inch pan. Stir sugar and apples together; set aside. Sift flour, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt together in a medium bowl.

review.reviewBody: Yum-eee. I switched this up a bit by reducing the sugars to 1C br. sugar and 1/2C white sugar (as I was going to add a glaze to the finished cake), replacing 1C of the flour with whole wheat flour and adding 1/4 tsp cardamom along with the cinnamon. And as dense as the batter was, it baked evenly and was done at 35 min (in a glass pan). Then, to gild the lily, I poured Caramel Frosting VI on top. Moist, apple-y... just plain delicious. Thanks!

Make this cake! So simple and easily customizable. No mixer or special equipment needed. Your home will instantly smell like Fall. 

I've made this exactly as written and with my own changes. You can easily add more spices like nutmeg, cloves or ginger according to your taste. Subbing some of the for for graham flour or finely ground oatmeal gives it a lovely new texture. I typically make it with half the sugar and I don't miss it at all! 

My favorite way to serve it is with a dollop of fresh whipped cream. The cake is delicious and most and doesn't ( in my humble opinion) need anything else! 

Tip: After the first day, the cake will get a little sticky/moist, so store it in the fridge so it will last longer. To restore this cake to it's fresh out of the oven crispiness, reheat in the toaster oven for a few minutes and then serve. Enjoy!

This cake was so Moist and delicious! I made a few changes; I added 1/8 tsp ground cloves, 1/4 tsp nutmeg, 2 tsp baking powder (I omitted the baking soda) . I reduced the sugar to 1cup dark brown and 1/2 cup white. I mixed the brown sugar with the apples which I finely chopped. I added 2 tbsp of melted butter and whisked it with the 1/3 cup oil, the eggs and vanilla. And on the suggestion of another viewer Iserved it with the caramel sauce from the fresh apple cake III. Wonderful. Oh, I used Braeburn apples.

I followed some suggestions...reduce the sugars to 1 C br. sugar and 1/2 c white sugar. I used pecans instead of walnuts. I made the basic cream cheese frosting. OMG!!! It is so delicious and not "sugary" sweet. It was a smashing hit. I must give thanks to all the reviewers. Oh, depending on your own oven, I suggest begin checking for doneness after 30 minutes. And one more thing, chopping the apples into small pieces does the trick!!!

Love this recipe. I baked mine with a sweet potato pie inside....the latest rage, pie cake, and topped it with caramel frosting vi and toasted walnuts. The cake part was perfect for a 10 in. Springform pan (buttered parchment round on bottom) and 7 inch pie, and it baked dark and dense, moist and delicious. (See pic) I had to bake it an hour and 20 minutes, and it was difficult to tell when it was done since it was so thick, but basically felt the middle of the top for firmness. The edges were carmelized and yummy chewy, sooo good. The batter was very thick before adding the apples, but 4 cups of apples took care of that. Would definitely make this again!

Very good cake, made with 2 large Granny Smith apples and substituted 1 c of brown sugar for 1 c of white sugar, used 1 c of raisins instead of the walnuts and topped with powdered sugar glaze as soon as it was removed from the oven. Cooking time in an aluminum 9x13 pan was only 31 minutes however. Make sure to check cake after about 30 minutes .

This was fabulous! I cut the recipe in half and baked it in an 8x8 pan. I also added ground ginger and cloves for extra spice, but I’m sure it would have been just as good without them. I’ve already shared the recipe with others and will definitely be making it again!

I always read the reviews before I make something, I find other experienced cooks and bakers have similar issues with recipes. I saw that it was a heavy batter and dry, so lightened it up by adding 1/2 cup milk, alternately with the flour. I also cut down the sugar to 1 1/4 cups, and it was plenty sweet enough. The biggest thing I found, is that it was quite brown and well done at 37 or 38 minutes, so took it out - probably 45 minutes is too long for lots of ovens? Thank you for sharing.

Delish! I made this for a church 'harvest celebration' potluck, topped with caramel frosting VI from this site. I also used apples from my gravenstein tree, so that helped with the yumminess :) I used 1 1/2 cups of brown sugar only (no white). Also, I tossed the cinnamon in with the sugar/apple mix, and added about 1/2 tsp ground cloves, and 1/2 tsp ground ginger. It was excellent! I will keep this, and definitely make it again!

The most "apple" taste of the apple cakes! I've been making this for years with great reviews. The only differences in my recipe: 1 tsp soda instead of 2, Granny Smith apples, FINELY chopped, 3 tsp cinnamon instead of 2 & I use pecans. For those who take issue with the sweetness, too much vanilla or soda-like taste, using my recipe will address those problems. Granny Smiths are very tart (especially the greenest ones). By the way, vanilla is known to impart an impression of sweetness. I sometimes bake it in a tube pan for 1 hr. 10 minutes. And I've never needed icing (& I love icing!) Great with vanilla caramel ice cream.

I make this cake every year throughout the fall and winter. I love the delicious flavors of a mix of our local apples baked into this cake. The only thing I do differently is that I use 1 tsp cinnamon and EITHER 1tsp nutmeg OR 1.tsp ginger depending on the season. Blending the two spices really bumps up the flavor of the apples! Of course, I never forget my favorite cream cheese frosting!
I make this for church and it's always a big hit. I use whole wheat flour, brown sugar and add nutmeg. Deliscious!
everyone likes it

If you decide to make this cake, I recommend cutting the apples into small pieces, ~1/4-1/2” cubes would be good. I made 1/4” slices and quartered those. I think that affected the moisture in the cake. Also do not over bake.
Easy to make.
This is delicious! It's a keeper in our house. But I did change one thing. Like one of the reviewers mention, I changed the sugar ingredient to 1 cup of brown sugar and 1/2 cup of white sugar.
Very moist & tasty! Excellent recipe. Will definitely do again! I made no changes......good as is.
I cut the recipe in half and used a 8x8 pan. I used a little less sugar and more
Everyone loved it!!!
Look good
